applied_rules.rule: Use saved portfolio/transaction/history/performance routes; preserve BUY/SELL immutable identity, response replay and uncertain mutation result.
applied_rules.implementation: PortfolioClient holdings/create/update/delete/histories/performance; PATCH strips assetId/type; mutation validates transactionId/holding/realized sum

applied_rules.rule: Keep public calculation separate from saved portfolio writes and preserve partial/null/date status.
applied_rules.implementation: PortfolioClient.calculate delegates POST /api/portfolio/calculate; CoreScreens evaluation labels partial/mixed dates and nullable totals

applied_rules.rule: Construct decimal values from source text, preserve numeric JSON lexemes and field precision; never route money through Double.
applied_rules.implementation: coreDecimal BigDecimal source content; PortfolioClient raw JsonObject preserves lexemes; UI string drafts and JsonPrimitive(BigDecimal) requests

applied_rules.rule: Do not replay writes on network failure; distinguish HTTP rejection, malformed success, cancellation and outcome uncertainty.
applied_rules.implementation: SessionHttpTransport one-shot JSON RequestBody; ApiException status/code retained; mutation response boundary; root VM unknown + explicit reload; CoreScreens disables repeat submit

applied_rules.rule: Validate root object/array, required safe IDs and mutation shape without collapsing null into missing success.
applied_rules.implementation: PortfolioClient holdings/histories/mutation; coreObject/coreElement/coreId; holding null remains legal full-sale result
